name: Saginomiya Konoe
source:
A second-year student in the Pillar, Konoe is the older of the two Saginomiya sisters. She has received the blessing of Leo.

She won a surprise victory in the last year's election, breaking the ruling clique's grip on the student council. This upset came to be known as 'the Leonine Revolution'.

During the election, she kept her younger stepsister Homare at arm's length. The reason for that was...

[spoiler]Following the wishes of her family, she is currently aiding Hikari with her covert activities in the Academy.[/spoiler]

[Based on [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221024151940/http://www.virgo-resistance.sakura.ne.jp/watamari/]three[/url] [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1403933442069303301]separate[/url] [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/2009865553901695245]descriptions[/url] provided by the author.]
